The two crossings extracted from the worked examples are listed below. The Crossing column gives the index pair labelling the crossing; Parent type records its proton–neutron classification; and Matrix names the transfer matrix that governs it. Both crossings are classified as proton–neutron "mix" crossings, so both rows resolve to the mix transfer matrix T_{\mathrm{mix}}.
